I studied physics and work on optimization problems in aviation. This site documents a
structured, from-scratch path through machine learning: deriving the mathematics,
implementing the algorithms myself (Python, C++, Java), and testing them with
reproducible experiments.

**What you'll find here**

- [**Projects**](projects.qmd): from-scratch implementations with tests, ablations and
  written results, from numerical linear algebra kernels to scientific ML.
- [**Reading Ledger**](ledger.qmd): short, structured summaries of the papers I read.
- [**Blog**](blog.qmd): explainers that connect physics intuition to ML, plus
  reproduction reports (including the negative results).

**Interests:** scientific machine learning, optimization, numerical methods,
and ML systems.
